audience.text: Building homes in Irvine? Small builder, or nonprofit? This one's for you.

problem.text: Land to keys takes four-plus years. And one missing document can delay the whole project.

purpose.text: HouseX checks your plan set against Irvine's permit rules, before you submit.

demo.text: Add your address and plans. In under two minutes, you get the missing documents and code conflicts, each with its source.

payoff.text: Fewer correction rounds. Fewer months of loan interest. That's HouseX.
